items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: John Marrero. No, Billy, Billy Marrero. Billy Marrero.

ctx.x: Did you sell him a horn or what was that?

I learned something. I learned something to play one. He had a job at the, at the cooperatives. And, uh, his horn broke. He never had no good horn. He said, the only last one, he was moved to Dave. He thought he bought a horn. And, uh, he said, uh, Joe. I said, what you want? I said, you want a horn, I guess. I said, before he came out, he said, yeah, I'm going to borrow your horn. I said, I listen to Buddy, I'm going to lend him a horn. I said, I'm going to keep two. Right there's three, sometimes two. I kept…
